serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
You: I was at fault too.
You: I didn’t take your feelings into account. I had no idea what you were going through.
Lady Annalie: Forget about it. I’m glad we put that past us. 
You: I know that it might be insensitive, but I and {f_botName} really want to leave this city. No other place besides Paradisium will make it for us.
Lady Annalie: So I heard. {f_botName} didn’t want to go into any details, but she got the point across.
